ac3.command:
set -u
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ac3 RED: python3 missing"; exit 1; }
r=docs/criteria/req_coverage_verification.md
test -f "$r" || { echo "ac3 RED: $r missing"; exit 1; }
# CRLF discipline: every leg greps a CR-stripped copy (git checkout normalises
# this worktree to CRLF while the generator emits LF).
n=$(mktemp) || { echo "ac3 RED: mktemp failed"; exit 1; }
tr -d '\r' < "$r" > "$n"
grep -qE '^REQ_MATRIX PASS rows=749 unique=749 idset=sha256:ef6c4bba27791a79$' "$n" \
  || { echo "ac3 RED: the matrix is no longer 749 rows / 749 unique / the pinned idset prefix - the move must not change the id set"; rm -f "$n"; exit 1; }
for pair in IMPLEMENTED_TESTED:116 IMPLEMENTED_STRUCTURAL:622 DEFERRED_RULLED:10 GAP:0 EXAMPLE_REFERENCE:1; do
  k=${pair%%:*}; v=${pair##*:}
  grep -qxE "REQ_STATUS_COUNT $k $v" "$n" || { echo "ac3 RED: REQ_STATUS_COUNT $k is not $v (the measured post-move tally is 116/622/10/0/1)"; rm -f "$n"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qxE 'REQ_STATUS_COUNT (IMPLEMENTED_TESTED 111|DEFERRED_RULLED 15)' "$n"; then
  echo "ac3 RED: the report still carries the HEAD tally 111/15 - it was not regenerated after the move"; rm -f "$n"; exit 1
fi
python3 - "$n" <<'PYAC3'
import sys
text = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().replace("\r\n", "\n")
lines = text.split("\n")
keys = {l.split("key=")[1].split(" ")[0] for l in lines if l.startswith("REQ_DEFERRAL_KEY PASS key=")}
want = {"LIVE_AGENT_SESSION", "LIVE_MCP_SUBPROCESS", "LIVE_SUBAGENT_LAUNCH",
        "RULING_FE_PERF_LIVE_PROFILING", "RULING_TECH_DATEFNS_OVERRULED"}
assert keys == want, "deferral keys %s != %s" % (sorted(keys), sorted(want))
rows = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("REQ_ROW PASS id=")]
for rid in ["REQ-OPS-061", "REQ-OPS-062", "REQ-CICD-041", "REQ-DOC-070", "REQ-PROD-041"]:
    hit = [l for l in rows if (" id=" + rid + " ") in l]
    assert len(hit) == 1, rid + " is not present exactly once (the move is a replacement, not a disappearance)"
    assert " status=IMPLEMENTED_TESTED " in hit[0], rid + " is not IMPLEMENTED_TESTED after the move: " + hit[0][:120]
    assert " deferral_key=" not in hit[0], rid + " still carries a deferral_key"
bad = [l for l in rows if " deferral_key=LIVE_DEPLOYMENT_STATE " in l]
assert not bad, "a row still defers on the moved key: " + bad[0][:120]
PYAC3
[ $? -eq 0 ] || { echo "ac3 RED: the deferral-key set, one of the five reclassified ids, or the no-stray-deferral_key rule failed"; rm -f "$n"; exit 1; }
grep -qE 'pointers=[^ ]*[.]ncbak' "$n" && { echo "ac3 RED: a pointer names a .ncbak scratch artifact - the report was generated from a polluted tree"; rm -f "$n"; exit 1; }
rm -f "$n"
echo "ac3 GREEN: 749 rows / 749 unique / pinned idset, the measured 116-622-10-0-1 tally, the deferral-key set without the moved key, the five formerly-deferred ids present exactly once as IMPLEMENTED_TESTED with no deferral_key, and no scratch-artifact pointer"
